benefits.name: United travel credit
benefits.notes: $200 United TravelBank cash each cardmember anniversary.

benefits.name: Renowned Hotels credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit for prepaid Renowned Hotels and Resorts stays booked through United Hotels; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Rideshare credit
benefits.notes: Up to $8/month in statement credits on rideshare purchases ($12 in December, $100/yr total); opt in every calendar year.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: Two Instacart credits each month ($10 + $5) in your Instacart account with an active Instacart+ membership (3 months free, then 50% off).

benefits.name: Avis / Budget credit
benefits.notes: Paid as United TravelBank cash: $40 on each of the first two Avis/Budget rentals booked via mileageplustravel.united.com per cardmember year.

benefits.name: JSX credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit on flights booked directly with JSX; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Award flight discount
benefits.notes: 10,000-mile award flight discount each anniversary; another 10,000 after $20,000 annual spend.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter while enrolled in DashPass via the card (12 months complimentary, then paid). Cardmembers who first activate DashPass 9/1/2026 or later get the $10 promo monthly instead.
